result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off restaurant card, truncated text, and inconsistent badge styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated and no visible delivery price.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll carousel properly clips or reveals full card content, or add a peek indicator so users know more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The badge on the second 'Popular right now' item (pizza) shows '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value.
issues.suggestion: Remove the discount badge if there is no actual discount, or only display badges when there is a nonzero promotional value.

issues.description: Inconsistent badge styling between cards: 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' uses a white pill badge with green text ('€0 delivery') while the pizza card below uses a white pill with black text ('-0%'), creating inconsistent visual hierarchy.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge color scheme and typography across all promotional badges for consistency.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is cut off by the screen/navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or ensure scrollable content isn't obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar.
